70907.subject: Technical Drawing
70907.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
70907.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

70908.subject: Technical Drawing
70908.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
70908.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Divide the circumference into six equal parts using a 60° set square or protractor.
3. Join the six points on the circumference to form the hexagon.
4. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

70909.subject: Technical Drawing
70909.question_text: Construct a tangent to a circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
70909.explanation:
1. Draw the circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join OP and bisect it to find midpoint M.
4. With M as center, draw a semicircle of radius OM to intersect the original circle at points T and T'.
5. Join PT and PT' to form the required tangents.
6. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

70910.subject: Technical Drawing
70910.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm). Use first-angle orthographic projection.
70910.explanation:
1. Draw the front view (40 mm × 20 mm).
2. Draw the top view (40 mm × 30 mm) directly above the front view.
3. Draw the right-side view (30 mm × 20 mm) to the right of the front view.
4. Ensure proper alignment and projection lines.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

70911.subject: Technical Drawing
70911.question_text: Given the front and top views of an object, draw the right-side view using first-angle orthographic projection. (Assume dimensions are provided in the diagram.)
70911.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the object's shape.
2. Project lines from the front and top views to construct the right-side view.
3. Ensure proper alignment and hidden details.
4. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

70912.subject: Technical Drawing
70912.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (assume a cylindrical object with a hole) along the vertical cutting plane A-A. Show all hidden details and hatching.
70912.explanation:
1. Identify the cutting plane A-A.
2. Draw the sectional front view by removing the front half of the object.
3. Apply hatching to the cut surfaces.
4. Show hidden details using dashed lines.
5. Label all parts and dimensions clearly.

70913.subject: Technical Drawing
70913.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Include all construction lines.
70913.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark the dimensions along the axes: 50 mm (length), 30 mm (width), and 20 mm (height).
3. Complete the block by drawing parallel lines.
4. Label all dimensions and construction lines clearly.

70914.subject: Technical Drawing
70914.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a square pyramid with base side 30 mm and height 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
70914.explanation:
1. Draw the plan (base) of the pyramid as a square.
2. Calculate the true length of the slant edge using $L = \sqrt{(25^2 + 50^2)}$.
3. Draw the development by constructing four isosceles triangles with base 30 mm and slant height L.
4. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

70915.subject: Technical Drawing
70915.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views (front and top) of a stepped block. Follow standard dimensioning conventions.
70915.explanation:
1. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
2. Use extension lines and dimension lines with arrowheads.
3. Dimension holes and radii appropriately.
4. Avoid redundant dimensions.
5. Label all dimensions clearly.

70916.subject: Technical Drawing
70916.question_text:
Draw a working drawing of a simple bracket with the following details:
- Base: 60 mm × 30 mm × 10 mm
- Vertical leg: 40 mm × 20 mm × 10 mm
- Hole: 10 mm diameter in the vertical leg
Include all necessary views, dimensions, and a title block.
70916.explanation:
1. Draw the front, top, and side views of the bracket.
2. Include all dimensions and hidden details.
3. Add a title block with the drawing title, scale, date, and name.
4. Ensure proper alignment and projection methods.
5. Label all parts clearly.
